title: A Virtual AI Influencer Pipeline for a UK Beauty Brand
subtitle: Running an entire AI influencer account end to end, no manual posting or planning
blurb: Built an n8n workflow for a UK beauty brand that runs a virtual influencer account end to end: weekly content planning, parallel image, video, and caption generation, and automatic publishing to Instagram.
result: Replaced a team manually planning, shooting, writing, and posting content each week with a single reviewable weekly batch

meta.solutions: n8n, AI Image and Video Generation, Content Automation

whoFor: A UK beauty brand wanting a consistent influencer-style content presence without relying on a human influencer partnership.
challengeIntro: Running an AI influencer account still meant a team manually planning content, producing images and captions, and posting on schedule every week, the exact overhead an AI influencer was supposed to remove.
challengePoints: No manual posting or content planning, the account needed to run on its own
Content needed a consistent identity, tone, and visual style across every post
Producing images, video, and captions by hand every week did not scale
builtIntro: Built in n8n: the influencer's identity, tone, and visual style are defined once as a source profile, then the workflow takes over from there.
builtPoints: A full week of content ideas generated automatically into a content calendar
Separate agents generate the images, video, and captions for each planned post in parallel
Approved content publishes to Instagram automatically on schedule
builtOutro: What used to take a team manually managing content, planning, shooting, writing, and posting now runs as a single reviewable weekly batch. The production work disappears.
capabilities: Parallel Image, Video, and Caption Generation
